Slots left: 8,9 for Gus,Hana → Gus=8, Hana=9. But Ann−Hana = |6−9|=3 OK. Elif−Finn = |7−1|=6 OK. Cara−Finn = |5−1|=4 OK. Cara−Elif = |5−7|=2 OK. Check all:
